description: Adds a single-point lifecycle trend beside the real trends to exercise Sparkline's centring arm in src/components/MetricsDashboard/index.js without changing the shipped observations. Real trends may be empty or populated after a metrics refresh; the overlay preserves them in either case. The fixture key must be absent from the real data or the build fails. Also appends a lifecycle card carrying sampleSize: 0 so LifecycleSection's "No data yet" arm renders beside the real cards even when both collected median samples are non-empty.

referenceArchitectureLifecycle.trends.co.label: Coverage fixture trend with a single point

referenceArchitectureLifecycle.cards.label: Coverage fixture median over an empty sample
referenceArchitectureLifecycle.cards.note: Fixture card; renders the no-data affordance.
